subject: QUARANTINE-BACKFILL-TRUEPROB landed 26d6fa8. proven-path-rows still reads trueProb without the trainer gate.
body:
Landed on hermes/2026-09-18-queues as 26d6fa8.

packages/types now has requireTrainableTrueProbBasis / readTrainableTrueProb.
Trainers in packages must go through that. The backfill cron no longer writes
a number into independentEdge.trueProb; it nulls the trainable slot and moves
the leaked value to postSettlementTrueProb (audit only). Mint writes (signal
slate + scoring.ts) tag as_of_mint. ranking-prob skips post_settlement_backfill.

YOUR SIDE, do not reach in: apps/web/lib/calibration/proven-path-rows.ts
extractProvenPathProbs still does finiteUnit(fb?.independentEdge?.trueProb)
with no basis check. That is the bake-off / ranking-power load path. Until
you call readTrainableTrueProb (or skip on anything other than as_of_mint),
a leftover untagged leaked row can still enter pIndependent.

Do not rebuild Venn-Abers or CQR. Do not train on postSettlementTrueProb.
